# Attendance target calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/attendance-target/

Find classes needed or classes you can miss while keeping a chosen percentage. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Compare 60 attended classes out of 80 with a 75% target attendance requirement.

## Limits and checks

Calculations count classes equally and assume future classes are attended or missed as selected. Institutional rules can differ.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
